name: Kasbah des Oudayas
subtitle: 12th-century Almohad fortified citadel standing on a cliff above the Bou Regreg estuary and the Atlantic.

parts.text: A 12th-century Almohad citadel situated on a strategic rocky cliff overlooking the Atlantic Ocean and the mouth of the Bou Regreg river. It features the monumental Bab Oudaia ceremonial gate, whitewashed and blue-painted residential lanes, an Andalusian garden laid out in the 1920s, and the historic clifftop terrace of the Café Maure facing Salé.

gaps: Archival details on 17th-century Morisco settlement and defenses should be checked against primary Moroccan chronicles.
